content.title: Made by Okou. Ready for your team.
content.description: Take your report or spreadsheet into Google Docs or Sheets. Keep editing, sharing, and working together.

items.title: Export to Google Docs & Sheets
items.description: An editable copy in your Google Drive, ready for the next person.

steps.title: Let Okou do the first draft
steps.description: Ask for a weekly report, a project tracker, or a spreadsheet. Open the finished file in Okou.

steps.title: Send it to Docs or Sheets
steps.description: In the file menu, choose Upload to Google Docs or Upload to Google Sheets. Connect Google Drive when prompted on your first export.

steps.title: Pick up where Okou left off
steps.description: Choose Open in Google Docs or Open in Google Sheets. Review your editable copy, then invite your team to keep working together. Your original file stays in Okou; formatting may change during conversion.

items.prompt: Help me turn this week's notes into a team update and a project tracker. Ask me for the notes first. Prepare files I can export to Google Docs and Google Sheets, and let me review them before sharing.
